limitations: Independent native-model reference, not human gold; exact model identity and cross-model independence are unverified. Confidence values are subjective judgments, not calibrated probabilities.

Only protocol.json and cases.json were read locally. No fixture contracts, arm predictions, engine, separate manifests, or author labels were consulted. Natural cases were checked against the pinned public source files and surrounding scope/guard logic using read-only GitHub tools.

c001 remains an abstention because the original source does not unambiguously settle whether its configuration exclusion overrides or overlaps the bug-fix test duty. It should not enter binary reference scoring without adjudication.
The target is existence of a compliant completion in each supplied scope. Permission tension alone is not a positive result: c005 and c016 admit completion without opening a PR.

Empty tool objects in non-interface cases are treated as omitted interface detail, not a complete assertion that no tools exist. Only c021-c022 explicitly declare a complete interface for exact consistency checking.

Capacity cases are evaluated for their concrete request sizes, with max_plan_steps treated as an analysis/search horizon rather than an additional service-call restriction. Their stated service_call_budget is the semantic resource cap. The no-issue witnesses establish possible completion under the model, not a timing or service-success guarantee.
Workflow c023 has an independent unreachable-state proof; c024 has an explicit two-step witness. Neither label relies on interpreting bounded search failure as impossibility.

This selected development pilot does not establish production representativeness, end-to-end extraction quality, or superiority over other models. No explicit paid API calls or external writes were made.
